lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Investigation or close reading: the triangle proportionality theorem

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the investigation asks for.

items.prompt: AB = 4 maps to DE = 12, BC = 5. Find EF.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what changes and what stays fixed before you answer.

items.prompt: In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 2 and 32. Find the altitude.
A 4 m pole casts a 4 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 24 m shadow. How tall is the building?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The parallel line creates corresponding angles, giving a smaller triangle similar to the original by AA, so the sides are in proportion.
The parallel line bisects both sides by definition.
The two parts of each side are congruent because the line is parallel.
The result follows from the Pythagorean theorem applied twice.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 5 corresponds to DE = 15. If BC = 13, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 12 and 12. Find the altitude.
A 3 m pole casts a 8 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 48 m shadow. How tall is the building?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: The Pythagorean theorem can be proved using similarity. Which statement correctly justifies it?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 9 corresponds to DE = 45. If BC = 6, find EF.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
